# semaphore_ex_audit_webhook_test (Action)

Creates a test audit delivery and attempts real outbound HTTP delivery using the selected signing key. Executes only through explicit Action invocation. Progress reports a bounded, non-secret summary.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_audit_webhook_test" "example" {
  config {
    key = "current"
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_audit_webhook_test.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `key` (String) Signing slot; omission uses current.
